newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE fall further in profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE fall further in profit-taking.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares continued falling for the third successive day on Wednesday as investors continued to take profits after a recent two-week surge.
A shares fell to $110.125 from $110.875 on Tuesday and B shares fell to $112.0 from $115.875.
The shares had rallied in the previous two weeks amid expectations that SOLIDERE will launch a $150 million GDR issue in October allowing non-Arab investors access to the market.
Turnover on the privately-operated Beirut Secondary Market (BSM), which trades only SOLIDERE shares, was 4,138 shares from 4,124 on Tuesday. Value was $461,169 compared with $465,508.
On the official Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE), only 5,530 Eternit shares were traded at $1.875 down from $1.9375 on September 16.
There was no trade in any of the other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs and Uniceramic.
The LISPI index fell 1.05 percent to 83.57. The BLOM stock index fell 1.43 percent to 955.07. Both indexes cover both markets.
